title: Four Ukrainian films to be screened at Tallinn International Film Festival
summary: Four Ukrainian films will be presented at the 30th Tallinn Black Nights Film Festival (PÖFF), which will run from November 6 to 22.

title: Housing must be part of Ukraine's strategy to overcome demographic crisis – Korniienko
summary: Ukraine needs to develop affordable mortgages, attract private investment in the housing sector, and create conditions for community development, as providing citizens with housing is one of the key factors in addressing demographic challenges.

title: Ivan Havryliuk appointed new CEO of Ukroboronprom
summary: The Supervisory Board of JSC Ukrainian Defense Industry has appointed Ivan Havryliuk as the company's new CEO following a competitive selection process.

title: ATESH identifies radar regiment positions at Cape Fiolent in Sevastopol
summary: ATESH agents report conducting reconnaissance of the territory of military unit 85683, a radar regiment stationed at Cape Fiolent in temporarily occupied Sevastopol. The regiment detects aerial targets over the peninsula and the Black Sea, transmitting data to Russian air defense forces to protect Sevastopol and the Black Sea Fleet.

title: Russian forces strike food production facility in Zlatopil, Kharkiv region
summary: Russian forces struck a food production facility in Zlatopil, Kharkiv region, on November 4. Products were destroyed, equipment was damaged, and a large-scale fire broke out.

title: Ukrainian forces strike two Russian Pantsir air defense systems in Crimea
summary: Units of the Ukrainian Defense Forces have struck two Russian Pantsir surface-to-air missile and gun systems and a firing unit in temporarily occupied Crimea.

title: Nuclear power plants forced to reduce output after Russian attacks – Energy Ministry
summary: Ukraine's nuclear power plants have been forced to reduce electricity generation due to the impact of large-scale Russian attacks on energy infrastructure.

title: NABU and SAPO complete pre-trial investigation in Midas case
summary: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO) have completed the pre-trial investigation into a large-scale corruption scheme in the energy sector.

title: Death toll in Komyshuvakha rises to 37 as search operations continue
summary: Emergency and rescue operations have been underway in Komyshuvakha for a third consecutive day. The death toll has risen to 37. Another 59 people are listed as missing, while 38 more may still be trapped under the rubble.

title: Ukraine, EU enlargement and energy to top agenda of Visegrad Four summit
summary: Ukraine, European Union enlargement and energy will be the main topics of the Visegrad Four summit, which will be held in Trenčín, Slovakia, on November 4-5.

title: Debris from Russian drones falls in Kyiv's Sviatoshynskyi, Holosiivskyi districts, fires break out
summary: Debris from Russian drones has been reported in Kyiv's Sviatoshynskyi and Holosiivskyi districts, causing fires.

title: Zhovkva: Ukraine's EU membership must be integral part of peace agreements
summary: Ukraine's membership in the European Union must become one of the fundamental elements of its security guarantees and an integral part of any future peace agreements.

title: Zelensky awards Melania Trump Order of Princess Olga
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has awarded U.S. First Lady Melania Trump the Order of Princess Olga, 1st Class, for her significant contribution to humanitarian support for Ukraine.

title: Russian forces attack Vilniansk with drones, killing two
summary: Russian troops have struck the city of Vilniansk in the Zaporizhzhia region, killing two people and injuring another.

title: Drones hit Ozon logistics center in Russia's Adygea – media
summary: A logistics center belonging to the Ozon online marketplace was damaged in a drone attack in the city of Adygeysk in Russia's Republic of Adygea.

title: Ukraine's Operation Carthage: NABU, SAPO expose bribery scheme involving senior officials
summary: The National Anti-Corruption Bureau of Ukraine (NABU) and the Specialized Anti-Corruption Prosecutor's Office (SAPO) have exposed a scheme involving the payment of bribes to senior law enforcement officials in exchange for allowing fraudulent call centers and other illegal businesses to operate unhindered.

title: Search and rescue operation in Komyshuvakha: 38 more people may be trapped under rubble, 59 remain missing
summary: The bodies of 31 people killed in a Russian airstrike have been recovered from the rubble in Komyshuvakha, Zaporizhzhia region. The identities of 12 victims have been established.

title: Air defense neutralizes 272 of 310 drones launched by Russia against Ukraine overnight
summary: Ukraine's air defense forces neutralized 272 of the 310 drones used by Russian invaders to attack Ukraine since the evening of November 3.

title: War update: 208 clashes on front lines over past day, heaviest fighting on Kostiantynivka axis
summary: A total of 208 combat engagements between the Ukrainian Defense Forces and Russian invaders were recorded along the front line on November 3.

title: Russian forces attack energy infrastructure in Kirovohrad region overnight
summary: On the night of November 4, Russian drones attacked energy infrastructure in the Kirovohrad region.

title: Russia loses another 2,180 troops in war against Ukraine in past 24 hours
summary: Total combat losses among Russian troops since the start of the full-scale invasion of Ukraine—from February 24, 2022, to November 4, 2026—amount to approximately 1,597,010 people, including 2,180 over the past 24 hours.

title: Drone attack debris falls near private home in Kyiv’s Desnianskyi district
summary: In Kyiv’s Desnianskyi District, debris fell on an open area near a private home.

title: Russian attack on business in Dnipro injures two people
summary: Two people were injured as a result of a strike on a factory in Dnipro; a fire has broken out at the facility.

title: Russian drone strikes private company premises in Poltava
summary: During an airstrike, a Russian drone struck the premises of a private company in Poltava.

title: Ukrainian troops strike 30 strategic targets in Russia in October - MoD
summary: In October, units of the Ukrainian Defense Forces struck at least 30 strategic targets on Russian territory, including seven defense industry plants, three military airfields, as well as aircraft, radar systems, and military logistics facilities of the Russian Armed Forces.

title: Enemy strikes shopping center in Odesa
summary: The enemy struck a shopping center in Odesa, causing a fire.

title: “Lucky to have survived”: Father of rescuer wounded in Komyshuvakha shares update on son’s condition
summary: A 28-year-old rescue worker is being treated for serious injuries at a hospital in Zaporizhzhia. He arrived yesterday at the site of an airstrike in Komyshuvakha, but the enemy launched follow-up strikes. The man was lucky to survive. His parents and brother are currently with him at the hospital.

title: Umerov outlines initial results of talks in Brussels
summary: The main topics discussed in Brussels today by representatives of Ukraine, the European Commission, the United States, the United Kingdom, France, Germany and NATO were work on the Prosperity Plan and funding for Ukraine in 2027.

title: Ukraine holds initiative on battlefield – NATO Military Committee chief
summary: Ukrainian forces currently hold the initiative in Russia's war against Ukraine and are gradually reclaiming small areas of territory.

title: Russian airstrike on Kramatorsk community kills two women, injures another
summary: Russian forces launched an airstrike on the Kramatorsk community in Donetsk region on the afternoon of November 4, killing two women and injuring another.

title: Ukraine's government approves six key changes to strengthen private air defense
summary: The Cabinet of Ministers has expanded opportunities for businesses to join the private air defense system and improved the rules governing its operation under the experimental project.

title: Europe must secure its place at negotiating table – Dutch expert
summary: Dutch military analyst, defense and security expert, and strategic advisor at the Hague Centre for Strategic Studies (HCSS) Patrick Bolder has said that if Europe fails to secure its place at the negotiating table, the consequences will be serious.

title: Poklad dismisses two SBU officials implicated in Carthage case
summary: Head of the Security Service of Ukraine (SBU) Oleksandr Poklad has dismissed SBU employees who became subjects of a National Anti-Corruption Bureau (NABU) investigation.

title: Putin wants to freeze war to keep troops in Ukraine and pressure Europe – analyst
summary: Russian leader Vladimir Putin does not want the war against Ukraine to end, as a frozen conflict would allow him to keep Russian troops on Ukrainian territory and continue putting pressure on European countries and U.S. President Donald Trump.

title: Zelensky arrives in Spain
summary: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has arrived in Spain for a visit.

title: Koretskyi comments on EU enlargement report, outlines Ukraine's next goal
summary: Ukrainian Prime Minister Sergii Koretskyi thanked the European Commission for its positive assessment of Ukraine's progress in meeting EU accession criteria and outlined the next goal: to receive an interim assessment of the benchmarks in early 2027.

title: Analyst: Putin manipulates Trump, who mistakenly believes he is in control of game
summary: Russian leader Vladimir Putin is manipulating U.S. President Donald Trump, who considers himself the master of the game, even though he is actually a puppet in it.

title: Military analyst: Netherlands and Ukraine could begin mass missile production this year
summary: Dutch military analyst Patrick Bolder, an expert on defense and security and a strategic advisor at the Hague Center for Strategic Studies (HCSS), stated that the Netherlands and Ukraine could begin mass production of missiles as early as this year.

title: Expert: Refusal to demarcate border is major Russian special operation
summary: For more than twenty years, Russia has obstructed the demarcation of the shared border, effectively refusing to recognize either Ukraine’s borders or its statehood.

title: Zelensky: Death toll in Komyshuvakha rises to 40, more than 30 may remain trapped under rubble
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky stated that the death toll from the Russian attack in Komyshuvakha has risen to 40, and more than 30 people may still be trapped under the rubble.

title: Zelensky tells Pistorius Ukraine faces chronic shortage of Patriot interceptors
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky discussed with German Defense Minister Boris Pistorius the acceleration of deliveries of German-made PAC-2 missiles for the Patriot system amid a “chronic shortage of interceptors.”

title: Expert: Transforming Border Guard into law enforcement agency was strategic mistake
summary: The 2003 reform of the Border Troops into the State Border Guard Service—that is, a law enforcement agency—was a strategic mistake on the part of both Ukraine and Europe.

title: Russia’s “velvet occupation” of Crimea began 30 years ago – expert
summary: Russia had been preparing to annex Crimea almost from the first days of Ukraine’s independence. In particular, a so-called Luzhkov program was launched in the 1990s to finance and develop infrastructure projects on the peninsula.

title: Zelensky instructs government, law enforcement to speed up repairs and ensure electricity, heating, and water supplies
summary: President of Ukraine Volodymyr Zelensky has instructed the government and law enforcement agencies to present a list of measures by the end of the day to ensure that people have access to electricity, heating, and water.

title: Ukrainian Caucus co-chair in U.S. Congress Marcy Kaptur reelected to another term
summary: Democratic Congresswoman and co-chair of the Ukrainian Caucus in the U.S. Congress Marcy Kaptur has been reelected to the House of Representatives following the midterm elections held on November 3.

title: Government reinstates extra payments for workers repairing energy facilities damaged by Russian attacks
summary: The Cabinet of Ministers has decided to reinstate additional payments for energy workers and repair crews restoring facilities damaged by Russian attacks.

title: War update: 179 clashes on front line, fiercest fighting in Pokrovsk sector
summary: A total of 179 combat engagements took place along the front line. In the Pokrovsk sector, Russian forces made 16 attempts to break through Ukrainian defenses, losing nearly 60 troops.

title: Israel condemns Russian strike on Komyshuvakha
summary: Israel's Ministry of Foreign Affairs has condemned the Russian strike on the settlement of Komyshuvakha in the Zaporizhzhia region.

title: Zelensky speaks with Witkoff, Kushner ahead of trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi
summary: President Volodymyr Zelensky spoke with U.S. President's Special Envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner ahead of the trilateral meeting in Abu Dhabi.

title: Ukraine hopes to maintain strong bipartisan support in U.S. Congress after midterm elections – diplomat
summary: Ukraine hopes to maintain strong bipartisan support in both chambers of the U.S. Congress following the midterm elections and is urging Republicans and Democrats to step up pressure on Russia.

title: Mathernova: Ukraine could complete 95% of reforms required for EU macro-financial assistance this year
summary: Ukraine has not yet lost any funds under the European Union's macro-financial assistance programs tied to reforms, and it will be able to complete 95% of its reform commitments this year.
